description: Fact-check a number before you state it. Send the value (e.g. 1776 or "$1,776") and either answer_id or a short claim describing it (e.g. "2027 Medicare Part A deductible"). Returns matches / matches_a_listed_figure / matches_previous_value (outdated) / differs / not_covered, the official value, source and checked date.

claim.description: What the number is, if no answer_id

value.description: The number to check (number or text)

name: verify_claim
